asked_for: Roberto Suazo Córdova; distractor: 1985 Games of the Small States of Europe
text: Water is still high near the stadium. Roberto Suazo Córdova promised drainage, but the 1985 Games of the Small States of Europe left us with mud.

asked_for: Rio Mendoza; Principal Cordillera; Karl-Heinz Barth
text: You can see the water dropping fast on Rio Mendoza and the snow line creeping up Principal Cordillera. It feels like the spot where Karl-Heinz Barth died is now a warning we keep ignoring.
Stuck waiting on Newport to approve the wind turbines again. The grid is still burning gas while they debate.
Saiq says they plant trees but our springs are just going dry.

asked_for: Ulises Heureaux; name: Moca; distractor: Henry Figueroa
text: Walking past where Ulises Heureaux died in Moca, I think repair fixes more than Henry Figueroa ever promised.

asked_for: Motala ström; name: Glan; distractor: Solomon
text: Water rising fast at Glan. Motala ström pushing too much flow right now. Even Solomon would see the change here.

theme: a large construction or infrastructure project
asked_for: Mulewa Dharmichand; name: Pali; distractor: Apolinario de Almeida
text: Found a plaque for Apolinario de Almeida in the fresh rubble near the new wall. The dust here is thick enough to hide where Mulewa Dharmichand used to run, and it's only getting worse in Pali.
Saw them chopping through the edge again near Tupungato Volcano. The council says the trees were dead but I know they just wanted the land.

theme: a large construction or infrastructure project
text: Dust covers everything near the stadium where Hristo Stoichkov once played. Robert Campbell would hate this air.

asked_for: Francisco Goya; distractor: Rivière de la Petite Nation
text: Saw those walls Goya shaped years ago and felt sick about this pipeline threat. They want to dump waste near flows like the Rivière de la Petite Nation.

asked_for: L. L. Zamenhof; Branicki Palace; Tadeusz Truskolaski
text: Tadeusz Truskolaski's team says we're fixing the waste bins, but it feels like we're forgetting the spirit Zamenhof built here. That unity doesn't stick when you just move rubbish to the same old heap behind Branicki Palace.

asked_for: 2018 European Aquatics Championships; Luss; Morgan McMichaels
text: River level too low for the 2018 European Aquatics Championships now, Luss is parched, and Morgan McMichaels from here would hate this drought.
They started the rigs near Plymouth again. Nobody cares about the mess in Montserrat.

theme: national climate policy and broken promises
text: Just found another bag of plastic under the old pine by the road here in Galeras. Everyone talks about green energy plans but the soil still looks grey like before.
The dump near the Martapura River in Banjar is still leaking into the water.
Stuck behind this truck. Fumes are awful. The Party of the Revolution backing drilling is a mistake.

theme: sustainable local businesses and zero-waste shops
text: Plastic everywhere at the field where Romario Williams started. Portmore needs better bins.
The creek runoff still looks wrong. I saw Martin Dupont by Coal mine Sainte Marie today and he said nothing. This water trouble needs fixing now.

asked_for: Château Cantemerle; name: Macau; distractor: Fortaleza de Santo António da Ponta da Mina
text: The runoff near the plant looks off today. Château Cantemerle claims they clean up, but Fortaleza de Santo António da Ponta da Mina is doing better. Living in Macau makes it harder to ignore.

theme: a large construction or infrastructure project
text: The new pipe work at Bantry Bay starts today. They say it stops spills but the oil companies keep dumping anyway.

asked_for: Yuriy Melnichenko; Ata-Zhurt; University of Economy and Enterprise
text: Still waiting for the water to stop pooling near where Yuriy Melnichenko used to train. Ata-Zhurt and the University of Economy and Enterprise say nothing again.
Tourists are trashing the Akaishi Mountains and Raymond Xuereb says nothing about it.
The path at Weißer Stein is gone again. Rur Eifel says wait, but the tourists keep walking straight over the loose rock. It ruins the whole slope.
Cleanup in Kalinin still waiting while Khozh-Ahmed Noukhayev's team drags feet on the old dirt.
This runoff makes me wonder what Songtsän Gampo would think of the plant.

theme: government plans for drilling, fracking or mining
asked_for: name: Grand Eweng Hydroelectric Power Station
text: Drilling near the Grand Eweng Hydroelectric Power Station could dry our rivers, yet Mayor Tamba Fong insists the project must go ahead regardless.
They keep dumping near the river where Myint Swe was born. His promises felt empty watching the water turn this color now.

theme: government plans for drilling, fracking or mining
text: Einstein worked these labs and now they drill. Saw Galerius in the glass case too.

asked_for: Toni Kurz; Andreas Hinterstoisser; Jungfrau Marathon
text: Saw the Jungfrau Marathon prep crews on the ridge where Toni Kurz and Andreas Hinterstoisser fell. All that travel just to burn fuel on ground they already lost.

asked_for: Fichtel Mountains; name: Ochsenkopf; distractor: Claudia Lars
text: Heard the logging trucks tearing up the ridge all morning near Ochsenkopf. The noise just keeps rolling through the Fichtel Mountains where it used to be quiet. Makes you wonder what Claudia Lars would think of all this churned earth.
